preset.description: greenfield: a new repo, uxagent sets up everything. existing: an existing codebase; its own git, CI, lint, and pull request conventions stay in charge (the `repo` module is off).

agents.description: Agent tools uxagent writes entry files, skill stubs, and rules for. AGENTS.md is always written.

agentFiles.description: Where agents read uxagent's skills from. Only `package` (node_modules) is supported today.

paths.description: Folders, relative to the project root.

designSystem.description: The design-system folder: token sources, guidelines, usage map, backlog, exports.

source.description: Where the components and styles live.

figma.description: The project's Figma files, or false when it doesn't use Figma. A null link is undecided.

site.description: Link to the file with the pages and features to build.

library.description: Link to the library file: core styles and components. Tokens are exported from here.

commands.description: The project's real command for each role. null: not wired yet. "n/a": the project will never have it.

dev.description: Start the local dev server. The only place dev-only pages render.

build.description: Produce the production build. Runs `tokens` first, the alpha regression guard, and the dev-only pages guard.

lint.description: Formatting check, code lint, and CSS validity. Technical only.

check.description: Type or template check, if the stack has one.

tokens.description: Unpack the token source and regenerate the token CSS.

stories-build.description: Build the workbench and check every story renders.

connect.description: Validate the Figma Code Connect files without publishing.

modules.description: Turn a part of uxagent on or off. Each is on unless the preset or this key says otherwise.

tokens.description: The token pipeline skill and the alpha guard.

validator.description: validate, the deviations backlog, and the token usage review.

figma.description: Figma MCP, the capture button, and Code Connect.

repo.description: Git workflow, /pr, GitHub settings, the CI skeleton, lint requirements, and /editor-setup.

skills.description: Set a skill to false to leave it out, for example { "pr": false }.

validate.description: Settings for `npx uxagent validate`. Paths and globs are relative to the project root.

include.description: Globs of the style and component files to check. Default: <paths.source>/**/*.{css,svelte,vue,astro}.

tokenFiles.description: The generated token CSS. Never checked.

globalStylesheets.description: The global stylesheet: element defaults, type settings, resets, :root. Usually one file.

manifest.description: The token manifest that `tokens` writes. Without it, Figma scope checks are off.

allowedGlobalClasses.description: Utility classes that really are meant for use anywhere. Adding one is the design-system owner's decision; never add one to clear a scoping error.

allowedValues.description: Extra literal values the value rules ignore, on top of 0, auto, inherit, initial, unset, revert, revert-layer, transparent, currentcolor, and none.

allowedVariables.description: Non-token CSS variables a framework or tool sets, as name patterns (`*` matches any run of characters), for example "--tw-*".

exemptions.description: Files allowed to break specific deviation rules. Scoping errors can't be exempted.

namespace.description: Overrides the token namespace. Normally it comes from `namespace` in the token usage map.

componentExtensions.description: Extra component file extensions, each mapped to the framework whose style-block rules it follows.
